behaviour: F1 (idb-keyval-update-lint-ban): any use of idb-keyval update() under app/src or app/pages (named/aliased/re-exported import, dynamic-import destructure or member, namespace member) fails `make test-unit`; comments and look-alike names do not.

F2 (rumor-journal-real-idb-suite): the journal's transactional and delete paths (recordRumorFailure, ackRumor + remembered failed acks, listPendingRumors, sweepRumorJournal, clearRumorJournalForGroup, getJournaledSenderLeafIdentity) are covered on fake-indexeddb with reject/abort/put-throw and per-call failure injection; every fault settles and leaves stored rows unchanged.
F5 (leave-fallback-identity-writeback): REJECTED in remediation round 1 — no write-back; a replayed leave without a journaled identity is skipped (never evicts a possibly re-joined member).

F3 (leave-clearpolldata-unguarded): a rejecting clearPollData during leave is warned and every later purge step, the MLS-state destroy, the tombstone delete, reloadGroups and markBackupDirty still run; the getGroupMembers guard and every other purge step are unchanged.

F4 (poll-pending-queues-recreated-after-purge): early-vote/close/announcement queue adds and removals read and write in ONE readwrite transaction, write nothing when unchanged, delete only a key that was read; clearPollData sets a per-group in-memory purge mark synchronously, and every queue write and saveVoteIfNewer (also without requirePoll) of a marked group writes nothing (queuePendingVote resolves false). The mark is released at the join choke point joinAndPersist (by the joined group's id, after saveGroup) and the already-joined accept, i.e. on every successful (re-)join, and by clearAllPollData.
P1: Privacy invariant untouched: local storage only, no new publishes.
non_goals: Cross-tab purge mark (another tab still processing a left group's poll messages can re-create a queue key; clearAllPollData removes it).
Guarding other leave purge steps (clearMessages etc.) or the getGroupMembers guard.
Purge-marking savePoll / allocateVoteSeq / receipt clock writes.
Retrying a failed clearPollData (left poll rows stay until clearAllPollData).
